part.text:
**Root cause:** `index.html` contained the correct `

BugBoing Demo

`, but `examples/real-agent-loop/site/app.js` overwrote it on load with `"BugBoing Demoo"` (extra "o"), so the extra character only appeared after JavaScript ran. **Fix:** Changed the runtime assignment in `examples/real-agent-loop/site/app.js` to `"BugBoing Demo"` and updated the stale comment. No other files were touched.
